snippet.title: One Piece World Seeker - Official 2ndTrailer HD (English)
snippet.description:
The Straw Hat crew arrives on Jail Island where an ominous sense of danger seems to be looming. What could have attracted the World Government and the Germa 66 to this place ? 
Discover more on the setting of One Piece World Seeker and this mysterious island occupied by the Marine; and how the arrival of the Straw Hat Crew will shake the island to its core ! 🏞
